zoe-sales: Customer (RegulaBank) asked for a 10-day EU-only POC. Must provide: signed subprocessors list, a routing assertion + simple traceroute/log sample for auditors, BYO-KMS pricing line, and a hosted vs dedicated delta. Can presales triage?
hugo-se: Quick clarifiers: which model are they validating? sustained RPS and peak? Do they need BYO-KMS enabled during the POC or only priced as an option?
zoe-sales: They're starting with rwd-medium, ~18 RPS sustained with short bursts to 75. BYO-KMS required for future prod; for POC they want it optioned on the quote and a note about key provisioning timeline. Auditor specifically asked for a traceroute sample showing no hops outside EU and an ops statement.
marta-ops: We support tenant pinning to EU regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1. Typical subprocessors we disclose: AWS (EC2,S3), Cloudflare (edge), Sentry, Datadog. I will export the CSV and include links to SOC2/ISO artifacts.
marta-ops: For traceroute auditors like, we can supply a sanitized run from our edge gateway to the pinned region and an engineered statement: "With tenant pinning + geofence on, control-plane signaling and inference payloads remain within the selected EU region; runtime does not route inference egress to non-EU regions for pinned tenants." Need Legal to sign the attestation.
hugo-se: Cost bullets for quote: hosted short POC estimate -> model compute + per-token egress overhead ~€0.038/token; Dedicated reserved -> egress billed at cost+margin ~€0.009/token but requires commit; BYO-KMS add-on -> one-time setup €1,750 + per-token key handling €0.011. Also note Dedicated gives SLA and optional hot-standby across EU zones for resilience (higher cost).
li-legal: I can sign a subprocessor attestation and the routing statement once Sales/Ops drop the subproc CSV, traceroute sample, and the exact wording for liability around BYO-KMS. Need the quote numbers to evaluate liability exposure.
build-bot: artifact: regulabank-poc-config v3 uploaded to staging at 2024-07-12T10:03Z
marta-ops: Sample enforcement config we can share (sanitized):
```json
{"tenant_id":"regulabank-poc","pin_region":"eu-central-1","geofence_enabled":true,"fallback":"none"}
```
zoe-sales: Who owns the Legal attestation coordination?
li-legal: I'll own it. Zoe, please attach the exported subproc CSV + traceroute sample and Hugo attach the POC quote with BYO-KMS lines. I'll draft attestation and post redlines.
hugo-se: Will add the BYO-KMS line items and a small hosted vs dedicated comparison table to the quote and upload it to the deal folder within 6h.
marta-ops: Uploading subproc CSV + SOC links and a sanitized traceroute now.
li-legal: Kicked off attestation draft review. Expect initial draft in 24h.
zoe-sales: Action items summarized: (1) marta-ops -> subproc CSV + SOC/ISO links + sanitized traceroute (2) hugo-se -> POC quote with BYO-KMS + hosted vs dedicated delta (3) li-legal -> draft & sign attestation once artifacts are in (4) zoe-sales -> schedule customer kickoff after attestation. ETA 48h.
li-legal: ACK, looping Compliance if any extra controls are needed. :white_check_mark:
zoe-sales: Thanks team — holding customer kickoff until attestation is ready.
